notes: Provisional, recalibrated after D-052 and D-053 (doc 07 s4.1 steps 1 to 4, spike 14). Method: 30 probes (18 answerable, 6 off_topic, 6 not_in_docs) run through the real search code with calibration=true on the 81-chunk corpus (text-embedding-3-small, k=5, top cosine among the returned chunks; script services/knowledge/scripts/probe_retrieval.py, one embedding request). D-053: tau_low and tau_high are computed over the 20 GENERIC probes only; the 10 S1 to S5 scenario probes are checks, each with its margin to the bar it is tested against (answerable: top cosine minus tau_high; off_topic: tau_low minus top cosine; not_in_docs: tau_high minus top cosine); a margin under 0.02 is flagged RISK. Focused, question-shaped sections were added to the refund-policy, support-and-escalation, roles-and-permissions and billing-invoices-payments articles (data/articles and Notion together); several headings echo the scenario questions, so those scenario scores measure the copy, not a paraphrase, and must not be compared with the golden-set run as if independent. Top cosine per probe, first-run baseline -> now, verdict under the current thresholds.
